Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.scheduler

Class EmbeddingScheduler

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.scheduler.EmbeddingScheduler
@Component public class EmbeddingScheduler extends Object
Scheduled job that embeds persisted articles into the in-memory vector store.

Runs on the cron schedule defined by aihealthcare.embedding.schedule in application.yml (default: daily at midnight). On each run it fetches all rows from news_articles, converts them to Spring AI Document objects, and calls VectorStore.add(java.util.List<org.springframework.ai.document.Document>).

The PgVectorStore persists embeddings in a PostgreSQL table with the pgvector extension. Because each Document is created with id = articleId, re-running this scheduler is safe and idempotent — an already-embedded article is simply overwritten in place; no duplicates accumulate.

If the embedding API call fails (e.g., missing or invalid API key), the exception is caught and logged as an error so that the scheduler thread is not terminated and subsequent runs can still succeed once a valid key is configured.
